units.source_text: 但是，苗子却打算今后对同千重子频繁接触、加深往来，更要慎重行事。

en.t: But from now on, Naeko intended to act even more cautiously about having frequent contact with Chieko and deepening their relationship.

units.source_text: 因为千重子的爱已经渗入她的身心……

en.t: Because Chieko's love had already seeped into her body and soul...
